message.text: Already in hand: the voice mastermind routed this to a Sonnet helper (helper-spawn-policy) a few minutes before I looked, with your grant as its brief. The rule is one line in Servex/agents/policy.js: an agent classed as a worker may spawn only minions and helpers, and the voice mastermind is classed as a worker. The fix lands on its branch; I restart Servex once it does, and the page mastermind and AI mastermind spawn as real masterminds from then on.
